comparison.objective: Measure voltage by simultaneously seating two probes in named L and N terminal openings.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually grasp and precisely insert two fine probe tips while avoiding neighboring openings.
comparison.success_condition: Both held tips reach the correct clamps/openings continuously for one second; entering another terminal zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: It shares fine tool alignment and insertion, but the tested ability is simultaneous electrical-probe placement. It has no unlock-adjust-relock sequence or iterative mechanical response criterion.
